description:
Powerful Mid-Drive Motor with Torque Sensor
Experience next-level performance with the ANNADA mid-drive motor, delivering 80Nm of torque—2.6× stronger than typical hub motors. The built-in torque sensor ensures every pedal stroke feels natural and intelligent, adjusting power precisely to your effort for a smoother and more responsive ride. Ideal for riders seeking a high-performance e-bike with premium control.
Removable & Integrated Battery Design
Enjoy both elegance and practicality with a 374.4Wh lithium battery seamlessly integrated into the frame. Ride up to 80-120 km on a single charge, and easily remove the battery for convenient recharging. TüV-certified for safety and quality, the BK33 supports your daily commute and weekend adventures with ease.
Smart Bluetooth Display & HITWAY App
Stay connected with the intelligent Bluetooth LCD display showing speed, mileage, and battery status in real time. Sync with the HITWAY App to track routes, analyze performance data, and personalize your riding experience — all from your smartphone.
Enhanced Comfort & Step-Over Frame
The BK33 features a step-over frame for a sporty and sturdy design, combined with a built-in seat suspension for extra comfort on longer rides. Weighing 26 kg, it balances stability and ease of handling, making it perfect for urban commuting and leisure rides.
Superior Multi-Terrain Performance
Conquer city streets and countryside trails alike with 26×2.35-inch puncture-resistant tires, lockable front suspension, and hydraulic disc brakes for enhanced safety and control. With a 25° climbing ability and 25 km/h top speed, the BK33 ensures stability on any terrain.
Practical & Stylish Design
Equipped with front and rear lights, a rear cargo rack, and 7-speed Shimano gearing, the BK33 combines style, comfort, and functionality. Whether for commuting or weekend adventures, it’s a premium mid-drive e-bike designed for everyday use.
